main.description: Marks where members-only content begins and declares which publication members can read past it.

audience.description: Whether access is available to all subscribers, all paid members, or selected paid tiers.

tierIds.description: Paid tier ids that grant access when audience is tiers. An empty selection grants no membership access.

widerReleaseAt.description: When an early-access gate widens to widerReleaseAudience. Absent when the gate never widens.

widerReleaseAudience.description: Who can read past the delimiter once widerReleaseAt passes, in addition to the original audience. public removes the gate entirely.

tiers.description: Members of the selected paid tiers.

tierIds.description: Paid tier ids that grant access. An empty selection grants no membership access.
